title: Multimodal Rapport Estimation in Real-World HRI
abstract: arXiv:2608.18401v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating interaction quality in real-world HRI is an important challenge. If interaction quality can be estimated reliably, the results can be used to improve dialogue strategies and ultimately enable robots to adapt their behavior autonomously. However, existing automatic evaluation methods have been developed primarily in controlled laboratory settings, and it remains unclear whether they can be directly applied to real-world environments, where users are free to disengage and multi-party participation may arise naturally. In this study, we investigate the automatic estimation of third-party-rated rapport scores using 62 sessions of multimodal recordings collected in a Japanese drugstore. We compare zero-shot LLMs, pretrained text, audio, and visual models, and their prediction-level fusion. translated_title: 真实世界人机交互中的多模态融洽度估计
translated_abstract: 评估真实世界人机交互（HRI）中的交互质量是一个重要挑战。如果能够可靠地估计交互质量，其结果可用于改进对话策略，并最终使机器人能够自主调整行为。然而，现有的自动评估方法主要是在受控实验室环境中开发的，目前尚不清楚它们能否直接应用于真实世界环境，在真实世界中，用户可以自由脱离交互，多方参与也可能自然出现。在本研究中，我们使用在日本一家药店收集的62个会话的多模态记录，探讨了第三方评分的融洽度分数的自动估计。我们比较了零样本大语言模型（LLM）、预训练的文本、音频和视觉模型，以及它们的预测级融合。结果表明，在真实世界HRI中，零样本LLM表现出强劲性能，而音频和视觉模型往往提供互补信息。
tldr: 本研究发现，在真实世界人机交互中，零样本大语言模型能有效估计融洽度，并与音频和视觉模型互补，为摆脱实验室限制的自动交互质量评估提供了新路径。
en_tdlr: This study finds that zero-shot LLMs effectively estimate rapport in real-world HRI, complementing audio and visual models, offering a new path for automatic interaction quality assessment beyond lab settings.
